svg.title: RuneScape contribution garden with crossover visitors
svg.desc: A high overhead RuneScape-style garden, with 182 daily contribution tiles from Cameron's actual GitHub activity, 2026-04-25 through 2026-10-23. 2,071 contributions, 173 active days, a 45-day best streak, and a 6-day current streak. A player in full rune armour carries a dragon scimitar without a shield; a blue-robed wizard carries a staff of fire, and goblins wander near the trees. A third human chops a willow with a rune axe, beside a rooted stump and logs. A plain iron-bound bank deposit chest, pointed rail fencing, mining rocks fishing ripples and an angular white-patched cow evoke the skilling areas of RuneScape. A fourth human smith works a hot bar beside a tapered brick furnace. An OSRS-inspired stone-framed quest list presents the same real statistics at lower right. Calendar columns are Sunday-first weeks; blank edge slots fall outside the displayed 182-day window. The current day is partial. Featuring a Pokemon trainer, Mudkip, Naruto, Gon, Killua, Link, a Creeper, Chao, Alexander, Nessie and a murloc. Ten visitor actions use native held-pose animation; Nessie and the contribution statistics stay still.

g.aria-label: Pokemon Trainer Red tossing and catching a Poke Ball
Mudkip giving a small hop and dorsal fin flick
Naruto makes hand signs and briefly summons a shadow clone
Gon Freecss casting, waiting, and reeling a fishing rod
Killua Zoldyck throwing and catching a metal yo-yo
Link stepping to open a chest, inspecting a rupee, and closing its lid
Alexander proudly taps his terracotta chest
Tiny green Apex Nessie beside the pond reeds
Murloc shuffles along the bank and lifts its spear
A curious Creeper peeks around the garden
Tiny blue Sonic Chao with yellow orb and small pink wings
